request.style: English, bright solo female voice, gentle choir backing, acoustic guitar, piano, celesta, soft drums, curious and gentle mood, 90 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Pul king of Assyria invaded the land
Menahem gave him a thousand talents of silver
To gain his support and secure his hold
Menahem raised the silver from every wealthy man
Exacting fifty shekels to pay the king
So the king of Assyria withdrew and did not remain

[Chorus]
The king who withdrew did not stay in the land
Silver collected from the men of Israel
A thousand talents paid for safety and peace
The army turned away from the kingdom's gate

[Verse]
Tiglath-Pileser came against Ijon and Abel
Capturing Janoah and Kedesh and Hazor
Gilead and Galilee were taken too
The people deported to the lands of Assyria
Ahaz sent messengers with gold and silver
From the house of the LORD and royal treasuries
To rescue him from Aram and the king of Israel

[Chorus]
The king who withdrew did not stay in the land
Silver collected from the men of Israel
A thousand talents paid for safety and peace
The army turned away from the kingdom's gate

[Bridge]
God stirred up the spirit of Pul and Tilgath
Carrying away the Reubenites and Gadites
And the half-tribe of Manasseh to exile
Halah and Habor and Hara and the river

[Outro]
Where they remain to this day
The silver paid for time
